Title: Suresh and the Family

Cast

1. Suresh - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Rajesh - 64 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
3. Sunita - 32 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd

Scene 1: The bazaar - Day

[Suresh stands in the bazaar. Rajesh stands near him.]

Suresh: "What lovely weather!"

[Suresh chases the thief through the crowd.]

Suresh: "Let's see."

[Suresh shouts for help.]

Rajesh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
